prerequisites: Basic knowledge in Software Engineering is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: The students can describe and apply concepts of software development for medicine.
The students can show connections to computer science.
The students can apply the thought processes and working methods of regulatory authorities to specific questions, including technically motivated problems.
The students have an intuition for the development of software as a medical device and can translate this into precise terms and formal justifications.
The students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: How does the regulatory framework fit software development processes?
Selected topics from quality management: (usability, risk management, configuration management)

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written exam

assessment_rules: The grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance is either an oral examination (individual examination) or a written exam.
